Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A user-owned AVYAKT AI conversation session stored under users/{userId}/conversations.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the conversation owner.

lastMessagePreview.description: Preview of the most recent message (0-160 chars).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message inside a user's AVYAKT AI conversation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

fromUser.description: True when sent by the user; false when generated by AVYAKT AI.

placeholderResponse.description: Whether the message originated from placeholder preview mode.

pictureUrl.description: Optional public image URL returned by picture search.

pictureCaption.description: Optional caption for the attached picture.

pictureSourceUrl.description: Optional Wikipedia source page URL for the picture.

cameraSnapshotNote.description: Optional compact badge note for camera vision turns.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{conversat.description: Owner-isolated chat messages belonging to a conversation.
